The Chicago Bulls, 1-1 and second in the Central, host the Washington Wizards, also 1-1 and second in the Southeast, in the Bulls' third game of the season. Chicago is 7th in the East and riding a one-game winning streak, while Washington is 5th in the East and has lost its last game.

Chicago is missing Nic Claxton (out, hamstring), while Noa Essengue (day-to-day, head bruise) and Patrick Williams (day-to-day, groin soreness, game-time decision) are also listed. Washington is without AJ Dybantsa (out, ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (out, knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (out, hip pinched nerve).

The two teams have not met yet this season, but the Bulls won all three meetings in 2025-26, most recently 119-108 in Washington on April 9, 2026.
